regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header determines mapper 1 and exact 128 KiB PRG/128 KiB CHR sections.

regions.label: ChrTilePatterns
regions.evidence: iNES CHR ROM section; fixed 16-byte NES 2bpp tile storage, separate from CPU PRG and not executable.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian hardware vectors at CPU FFFA-FFFF in final PRG bank.

regions.label: NmiEntry
regions.comment: Hardware NMI entry; frame scheduling and transfer work, exact behavior reviewed further in commentary.
regions.evidence: Validated hardware-vector control flow; decoder successor traversal in startup effective MMC1 banks [0,1,14,15], stopping at mapper/call barriers. See static-discovery.json.

regions.label: ResetEntry
regions.comment: Hardware reset vector entry; disables interrupts and resets mapper serial state before jumping to initialization.
regions.evidence: Validated hardware-vector control flow; decoder successor traversal in startup effective MMC1 banks [0,1,14,15], stopping at mapper/call barriers. See static-discovery.json.

regions.label: IrqEntry
regions.comment: Hardware IRQ vector entry; preserves and restores CPU state.
